test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - GK/CA (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Articles 36 to 51 of the Indian Constitution does NOT deal with which issues?

options.text: Equal justice and free legal aid
Secure suitable legislation and living wage for workers
Secure a social order for promotion of welfare of the people
Control of economic fluctuations for the benefits of a person or group

solution:
The correct answer is __**Control of economic fluctuations for the benefits of a person or group**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Articles 36 to 51 of the Indian Constitution are part of the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP), which guide the government in making policies.
 
• These articles are focused on promoting social and economic democracy and ensuring welfare for the people.
 
• Key areas covered include equal justice, free legal aid, suitable legislation for workers, and securing a social order for the promotion of welfare.
 
• Control of economic fluctuations for the benefits of a person or group is not mentioned within Articles 36 to 51.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP)**:

 
 
• These principles are listed in Part IV of the Indian Constitution.
 
• They are non-justiciable, meaning they are not enforceable by any court.
 
• The aim is to create social and economic conditions under which citizens can lead a good life.
 
 
 
• **Article 39**:
 
 
• Directs the State to ensure that the citizens, men and women equally, have the right to an adequate means of livelihood.
 
• It also mandates that the ownership and control of material resources be distributed to serve the common good.
 
 
 
• **Article 41**:
 
 
• Mandates the State to provide public assistance in cases of unemployment, old age, sickness, and disablement.
 
 
 
• **Article 42**:
 
 
• Directs the State to make provisions for securing just and humane conditions of work and for maternity relief.
